newsitem.title: USA: Jacor files for $125 million in notes.
newsitem.headline: Jacor files for $125 million in notes.

text.p: Jacor Communications Inc said Wednesday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $125 million in senior subordinated notes due 2006.
The Cincinnati company said the notes will be underwritten by Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp and Merrill Lynch & Co Inc.

The net proceeds from the offering will be used in connection with the pending transaction to repay a portion of the outstanding debt under the credit facility and for general corporate purposes, including the acquisition of other broadcast properties.

Jacor, following consummation of the pending transactions, will be the second largest radio group in the United States as measured by gross revenue and will own and/or operate 93 radio stations and one television station in 23 broadcast areas.
JCC, a subsidiary of Jacor Communications Inc, is currently known as CitiCasters Inc, whose corporate name will be changed to Jacor Communications Co following its acquisition.
